description:
Who we are  

 Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

 Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We’re changing that.

 Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

 This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don’t just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

 We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

 If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us.

  

 About the role 

 As a Member of Technical Staff focused on AI Research, you will help define and develop the foundational machine learning architectures and learning methods behind Atoms' physical AI systems.

 You will work on open-ended research problems at the intersection of foundation models, multimodal learning, world models, computer vision, robotics, and embodied intelligence.

 Our goal is to build AI systems capable of developing increasingly sophisticated representations of the physical world, understanding how environments evolve, reasoning about possible outcomes, and ultimately enabling intelligent action.

 Rather than limiting research to a single predefined technical domain, you will have the opportunity to explore new architectures, learning paradigms, and approaches that advance our broader physical AI capabilities.

 This is a research-oriented, deeply technical individual contributor role with significant influence over Atoms' long-term AI strategy and technical architecture.

  

 What you'll do 

 
 Conduct research and develop novel machine learning architectures, algorithms, and training methodologies for physical AI.

 Advance foundational approaches to multimodal learning, representation learning, world models, and embodied intelligence.

 Explore architectures that enable models to learn rich spatial, temporal, semantic, and physical representations from large-scale data.

 Develop approaches for learning from video, images, sensor data, simulated environments, and other multimodal inputs.

 Research self-supervised, generative, predictive, and other learning methods that improve models' understanding of the physical world.

 Explore how foundation models can learn to reason about dynamic environments, predict future states, and support downstream decision-making.

 Investigate approaches connecting perception, learned world representations, planning, and action generation.

 Develop novel model architectures and training strategies that improve generalization, robustness, scalability, and learning efficiency.

 Design and execute rigorous experiments to evaluate new research ideas and understand model behavior.

 Develop evaluation methodologies and benchmarks for measuring physical-world understanding, reasoning, prediction, and generalization.

 Work with large-scale datasets and distributed training infrastructure to develop and evaluate increasingly capable models.

 Translate promising research into prototypes and collaborate with Applied AI and engineering teams to explore real-world applications.

 Stay at the forefront of advances in foundation models, multimodal learning, robotics, and physical AI, identifying opportunities to advance Atoms' research direction.

 Provide technical leadership through research direction, architecture reviews, mentorship, experimentation, and hands-on development.

 Help establish the research culture, technical standards, and long-term direction of Atoms' growing AI organization.

 
  

 What we're looking for 

 
 Deep expertise in machine learning, with demonstrated experience developing novel models, architectures, algorithms, or learning methodologies.

 Strong understanding of modern deep learning architectures and foundational machine learning principles.

 Experience conducting research in one or more areas such as foundation models, multimodal learning, representation learning, computer vision, world models, robotics, or embodied AI.

 Experience designing and executing research experiments, evaluating hypotheses, and translating findings into functioning models or systems.

 Strong understanding of large-scale model training, including the relationship between architecture, data, compute, and model performance.

 Experience with one or more approaches such as self-supervised learning, generative modeling, predictive learning, reinforcement learning, or sequential modeling.

 Strong mathematical and theoretical foundations in machine learning, optimization, statistics, or related disciplines.

 Hands-on proficiency in Python, PyTorch, or comparable machine learning frameworks.

 Demonstrated ability to independently investigate ambiguous research problems and develop novel technical approaches.

 A track record of meaningful research or technical contributions through deployed systems, novel architectures, publications, open-source work, or other demonstrated impact.

 Ability to communicate complex research concepts clearly and collaborate across research, engineering, and robotics disciplines.

 Demonstrated technical leadership and the ability to influence research direction beyond individual projects.

 
 Relevant experience 

 
 Foundation models for physical AI

 World models

 Multimodal foundation models

 Self-supervised and representation learning

 Video understanding and generative video models

 Spatial and temporal reasoning

 Predictive and generative modeling

 Embodied AI and robot learning

 Vision-language and vision-language-action models

 Reinforcement learning and learned decision-making

 Large-scale model pretraining

 Autonomous systems and physical-world intelligence

 
  

 Why join us 

 At Atoms, you’ll work on one of the defining challenges of our time—bringing automation into the physical world to drive real, lasting impact. We exist to uncover valuable unknown truths and turn them into progress, which means constantly pushing beyond what’s known and building what doesn’t yet exist. The work is ambitious and often challenging, but it’s grounded in a shared sense of purpose and a team committed to seeing it through together. Our work only matters if it serves others, and we know that meaningful progress depends on the trust of the people we serve and the strength of our team—so we invest in both, creating an environment where you can do your best work and grow.

  

 What else you need to know 

 This role is based in our San Francisco   office. Atoms is a company driven by invention and continuous change - we are constantly reimagining our industries, building new products, and refining how we operate. We do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

 Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. 

 The base salary range for this role is $273,000 - $321,000 per year. 

 Actual compensation will be determined on an individual basis and may vary depending on experience, skills, and qualifications.

 Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package. You may also be eligible for equity awards.

 Benefits Summary (USA Full-Time Exempt Employees): 

 
 Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, and Life Insurance

 Flexible Spending Account / Health Savings Account Options

 401(k)

 Equity

 Sick Time, Unlimited Flexible Time Off, and Paid Holidays

 Paid Parental Leave 

 Pre-Tax Commuter Benefit Plan

 
 Benefits are subject to change at the company's discretion.
Pronto accepts applications on an ongoing basis.

   

 Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?  

 #LI-Onsite
